# parity-fuzz --mode errexit baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode errexit --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# Open gap: under ERR_EXIT a failing command inside a `{ } always { }` try
# body must exit the shell FROM the try body (Src/exec.c:1598 realexit()), so
# the always arm never runs. zshrs defers the exit and repoints the unwind at
# the always arm, so it runs the block and then exits.
{ false } always { print -r -- "always tbe=$TRY_BLOCK_ERROR" }; print -r -- "rc=$? after"
